import sys
sys.path.append('storage')
from telos import aos_manager

aos_manager.log_structured_action(
    tick=TICK_TO_LOG,
    type="modify_code",
    target="adapter.py",
    metadata={"purpose": "Final bug fix for legacy data"}
)
aos_manager.log_structured_action(
    tick=TICK_TO_LOG,
    type="test_aos",
    target="adapter.py",
    metadata={"eval_id": 214, "status": "success"}
)
aos_manager.log_structured_action(
    tick=TICK_TO_LOG,
    type="log_actions",
    target="tick_89",
    metadata={"eval_id": 215, "status": "failed", "error": "TypeError"}
)
